correctness.rationale: Every uncentered shortest-path ball containing the hub is {c}, {c,v_j}, or V, and every ball containing leaf i is {v_i}, {c,v_i}, or V. Subtracting nonnegative hub baseline b, writing t_i=|f(v_i)|-b, q=max_i t_i, s=sum_i t_i/(k+1), gives maximal hub excess H=max(0,q/2,s) and leaf excess L_i=max(t_i,t_i/2,s). The cases L_i>=H and H>L_i yield |L_i-H|<=|t_i|/2+(k-1)/(2(k+1))*sum_{j!=i}|t_j|, including k=1,2. Summation proves C_k=(k^2-k+2)/(2(k+1)). Leaf singleton indicator yields equality for every k. Independent direct enumeration of graph balls and Fraction exact averages verified all 3905 sign patterns for k=1,...,5 with hub baseline 2 and offsets in {-2,-1,0,1,2}. The unrestricted bound rests on the analytic inequality, not finite tests.
